newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU pledges to encourage small firms into research.
newsitem.headline: EU pledges to encourage small firms into research.

text.p: European Union research ministers pledged on Thursday to try to encourage more of the bloc's small and medium-sized companies to take part in its multi-billion dollar research programmes.

Ministers said at a regular meeting that efforts should be made to help such companies profit from the 15-country bloc's research efforts, currently worth 13 billion European currency units ($16 billion) between 1994 and 1998.
The EU's statistics office Eurostat said earlier this week that 99 percent of firms in the bloc employed fewer than 50 people and accounted for half its jobs and half its total turnover.

Research ministers said smaller companies, often the leaders in technology, would be helped by easier access to details on relevant research programmes, by providing training in how to apply for funds, speeding up the release of research funds, helping to provide research partners and making research results more easily available. ($=0.81 Ecus) -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
